properties.note: Torpedo attack No. 1: three bow tubes (1-3) at the leading destroyer of the screen, range 3700, two correctly timed hits; claims one fleet type destroyer, TERUTSUKI class, damaged or probably sunk. Narrative (p11-p12): fired at 0128; at 0129 the carrier came out of the rain squall, 'a large carrier with island superstructure'; 0131 heard two hits in the leading destroyer while diving. At 0030 the narrative heard three explosions, 'hits from the SEA DEVIL's attack'

Torpedo attack No. 2: four stern tubes (7-10) at the third destroyer, range 2000, fired diving; two correctly timed hits (narrative: 0133); claims one fleet type destroyer damaged or probably sunk. Breaking-up noises 0205-0208 and, on another bearing, from 0211
